title: Present spending, later balance
hook: Two stated cases: explore the cash consequence of a smaller current payment.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the cash consequence of a smaller current payment affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Next, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the cash consequence of a smaller current payment in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
